facts.text: Both a --format with no value and a --budget followed directly by --format exit nonzero with empty stdout and stderr containing requires a value.
post with --dryrun, alone or beside a valid --dry-run, exits nonzero with unknown option and leaves the facts count at 0.
EveryUsageFlagIsAccepted fails if the distinct documented verb and flag pair count is not greater than 40.
Each extracted verb and flag pair is run with the dummy value x and fails the test on unknown option or requires a value.
serve with --port not-a-port exits nonzero and stderr contains --port must be an integer.
The caller flag sets include post --file - which reads the request body from stdin.
Run starts dotnet with Dossier.dll, sets DOSSIER_DB to the temp database path, writes stdin and returns exit code, stdout and stderr.
VerbFlags strips parenthetical prose from a usage string before splitting it into verb and flag tokens.
SplitTopLevel tracks bracket and angle depth so it splits a usage string only on a top-level pipe.
compile given --mode instead of --budget-mode exits nonzero with empty stdout and stderr that suggests --budget-mode.
FactCount opens a store connection and counts the rows in the facts table.
Run sets the child process working directory to the folder that holds the temp database.
RepoFilePath walks up from AppContext.BaseDirectory to find a repository file and throws FileNotFoundException naming the path otherwise.
Ops.Graph output equals JsonSerializer.Serialize of the store graph for the same request, both using JsonCodec.Options.
The graph JSON contains max_nodes 500 and format 1, and never writes a null ambiguous or boundary field.
The MCP initialize reply's serverInfo version is asserted equal to ExpectedVersion.
With no arguments the CLI exits 1 and its stderr usage text lists init and version among the verbs.
A fact deduped against another serializes duplicate_of naming the original fact id.
PostResult wraps response and errors, and each error serializes its index, code and message.
Both the version command and --version exit 0 with stdout exactly the informational version plus a newline and empty stderr.
The parser accepts an upper-case IDEMPOTENCY_KEY and re-serializes it as idempotency_key with dry_run still true.
The round-trip preserves ref fields snapshot_hash, verified_at and etag and the attachment perceptual object.
BriefSearchResponse defaults complete to false and still serializes total 1 and refine r.
CheckSummary always emits conflicts 0 and gaps 0 even when the CheckResponse never sets them.
A compiled conflict with no resolution set serializes resolution as null rather than omitting the field.
CompileRequest reads budget_mode and rank recency and keeps an unknown follow object as raw JSON.
ShowResult always writes an empty inbound array and keeps JsonElement data and items verbatim.
VerifyResponse writes current false at the top level and on each fact unless the fact is current.
ChangesRequest parses since 12, last 3, limit 50 and subject Widget from JSON.
DumpRequest ignores the removed entity_subjects field while still reading source and tags.
DumpResponse always emits deduped and errors as empty arrays when nothing was deduped or failed.
The publish summary uses keys out, files, written, subjects, facts and removed in that order.
get_fact with an unknown id answers error code fact_not_found and message fact not found: nope.
The search next cursor decodes to JSON whose only property names are C, I and S.
Dumping a small Python file with Split none creates exactly 1 fact.
The dumped fact's first ref locator has a selector that starts with L1-L.
A fact posted through the CLI carries provenance actor dossier-cli, actor_type tool and channel cli.
Data keys on a shown fact serialize in sorted order as end_line, entity_kind, start_line and symbol.
The Json helper serializes any value with JsonCodec.Options.
The Parse helper deserializes JSON into a type using JsonCodec.Options.
Run starts Dossier.dll with dotnet, exports DOSSIER_DB only when a path is given and captures stdout and stderr.
ExpectedVersion reads the assembly informational version attribute and cuts the value at the first plus character.
The verify case covers superseded, stale, contested, live, retracted and unknown and validates VerifyResponse and VerifyRequest.
A changes page read past the current revision comes back with Reset true.
A compiled dossier over live, stale and contested facts passes dossier.schema.json and exactly 2 facts carry Why.
A VerifyResponse status of fresh is rejected with not in enum.
A VerifyResponse with no current field is rejected and the error names current.
PostOne posts one fact to a subject and returns the first fact id from the response.
The Errors helper validates an emitted value against a named definition in ops.schema.json.
docs/cli.md must document both memos/home and memos home, and each shown facts count and match label must equal what Check returns.
BlockAfter collects the doc lines after an example until a blank line or the next shell prompt.
SKILL.md frontmatter must define name as dossier and every dossier verb it quotes must appear in the Program.cs usage string.
The rules section between Rules the schema cannot enforce and Commands must mention zero edges, data and key.
Correlate scoped to Unit.cs proposes 0 while the store-wide correlate pairs the two child facts.
Check on the symbol subject Unit.cs::A reports Match exact_name.
A subject-scoped correlate proposes only pairs whose fact and ref target both belong to the scoped subject.
shared_tag pairs two facts that share a tag and finds nothing for untagged facts, while same_ref still pairs facts whose only difference is the locator line.
Show by fact id omits the subject name from its JSON, and check by subject id reports Match exact_id.
PostSymbol posts a symbol subject under a parent unit and returns the new subject id.
The seed image's SHA256 and byte length equal the sha256 and bytes declared in scripts/seed/memos.json.
scripts/seed.sh copies the shot into the database blobs directory and computes its hash with shasum -a 256 or sha256sum.
Publishing the seeded database returns 0 warnings, a single assets file named from the first 8 hash characters whose bytes equal the image.
DeclaredAttachment returns the first attachment's sha256, filename and bytes from scripts/seed/memos.json and throws when none exists.
ReadRequest deserializes a seed JSON file with JsonCodec and throws when it is not a post_facts request.
